summary: Green Dot Corp filed an 8-K reporting stockholder votes at a special meeting regarding a complex merger and separation transaction. Under the Merger Agreement dated Nov 23, 2025, Green Dot and CommerceOne will merge into New CommerceOne via two-step mergers, followed by a separation: Green Dot converts to an LLC, distributes its bank subsidiary to New CommerceOne, and Payments Buyer acquires Green Dot's non-bank fintech assets. No vote totals or deal price disclosed. The board recommended the proposals. Watch for regulatory approvals and closing timeline; risk-arb focuses on successful separation and merger completion.
